index 4a19458..1df2161 100644
--- a/tests/test_wordcount.py

+import pytest
+
 import wordcount
 
 
@@ -15,3 +17,28 @@ def test_main_prints_every_word(tmp_path, capsys):
     p.write_text("b a b", encoding="utf-8")
     wordcount.main([str(p)])
     assert capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines() == ["b 2", "a 1"]
+
+
+def test_format_counts_top_limits_output():
+    counts = wordcount.count_words("b a b c")
+    assert wordcount.format_counts(counts, top=2) == ["b 2", "a 1"]
+
+
+def test_format_counts_top_larger_than_vocabulary():
+    counts = wordcount.count_words("b a b")
+    assert wordcount.format_counts(counts, top=10) == ["b 2", "a 1"]
+
+
+def test_main_top_prints_only_n_words(tmp_path, capsys):
+    p = tmp_path / "t.txt"
+    p.write_text("c c c b b a", encoding="utf-8")
+    wordcount.main([str(p), "--top", "2"])
+    assert capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines() == ["c 3", "b 2"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["0", "-1", "abc"])
+def test_main_rejects_invalid_top(tmp_path, bad):
+    p = tmp_path / "t.txt"
+    p.write_text("a b", encoding="utf-8")
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        wordcount.main([str(p), "--top", bad])

--- a/wordcount.py
+++ b/wordcount.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-"""Count words in a text file: python wordcount.py FILE"""
+"""Count words in a text file: python wordcount.py FILE [--top N]"""
 import argparse
 import re
 from collections import Counter
@@ -8,19 +8,37 @@ def count_words(text):
     return Counter(re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text.lower()))
 
 
-def format_counts(counts):
-    """Most common first; ties in alphabetical order."""
+def format_counts(counts, top=None):
+    """Most common first; ties in alphabetical order. top limits output to the first N."""
     items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
+    if top is not None:
+        items = items[:top]
     return [f"{word} {n}" for word, n in items]
 
 
+def positive_int(value):
+    try:
+        n = int(value)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{value!r} is not a whole number")
+    if n < 1:
+        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("must be at least 1")
+    return n
+
+
 def main(argv=None):
     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Count words in a file.")
     parser.add_argument("path")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--top",
+        type=positive_int,
+        metavar="N",
+        help="show only the N most common words (default: all)",
+    )
     args = parser.parse_args(argv)
     with open(args.path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
         counts = count_words(fh.read())
-    for line in format_counts(counts):
+    for line in format_counts(counts, args.top):
         print(line)
     return 0
